## Scope

Describe the smallest reviewable change and its approved spec/plan reference.

## SDD/TDD evidence

- [ ] RED observed for each behavior change.
- [ ] GREEN and refactor complete.
- [ ] Exact `MD-REQ-*` traceability updated where applicable.
- [ ] Adversarial eval expectations updated where applicable.

## Verification

- [ ] Repository tests pass.
- [ ] Plugin tests pass.
- [ ] `ruff` and `mypy` pass.
- [ ] Boundary/freshness checks pass.
- [ ] Recorded the exact PR head SHA used for CI evidence.

## Human gates

- [ ] Human merge authorization is explicit and separate from green CI.
- [ ] Release publication is not implied by merge approval.
